description:
Use Bazaar Trader to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat from step 2.
